subject: Temporary capacity top-up request & prorated pricing clarification
messages:
From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@brightcommerce.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightCommerce Billing <billing@brightcommerce.com>
Date: 2026-10-04 09:12 -0700
Subject: Quick question — short-term capacity bump for Black Friday

Hi Karthik,

We have a Black Friday spike window (Nov 26-28) that looks materially larger than our normal run rate. Our engineering team expects token volume to be ~6x the usual for a 72-hour burst. Can Redwood provision a temporary quota expansion for that window?

Two quick pricing/contract questions:
- Will we be billed at the standard usage rate for the extra tokens, or is there a short-term uplift?
- If we commit to a short-term reserved top-up, can you prorate the cost and provide any one-time discount for an annual customer like us?

We need the capacity guarantee by Nov 10 to finalize our launch plan.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Cho
Head of Product
BrightCommerce

--
Attachment: forecast_q4_bf.csv (csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@brightcommerce.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-04 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question — short-term capacity bump for Black Friday

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads-up and the CSV. Congrats on the product timing — sounds exciting.

Quick answers up front:
1) We can provision a temporary quota bump for a fixed window.
2) For short-term top-ups we generally bill actual usage at the standard hosted rates unless the customer requests a reserved top-up (provisional capacity) which is charged as a time-bound commitment and can be prorated.

Proposal (fast option):
- We provision a "provisional capacity" pool sized to cover ~6x expected volume for Nov 26-28.
- Billing options:
  a) Pay-as-you-go: pay actual overage tokens at standard usage rate (no discount).
  b) Provisional top-up (recommended to guarantee capacity): purchase a 3-day provisional commit for the boost; we prorate to the number of days and can apply a one-time courtesy discount.

I discussed with Lauren and Ben about an appropriate concession given your annual relationship. Attached is a quick pricing worksheet with two scenarios (PAYG overrun vs 3-day provisional top-up) and the math for prorated billing.

If you want guaranteed capacity, option (b) is the cleanest path. If you choose (b) and sign before Nov 10 we can reserve the GPU pool for your account and set routing to prefer your tenant.

Next steps: let me know which billing path you prefer and I will route the amendment to Ben for a quick signature flow.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: provisional-capacity-pricing-sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04 13:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question — short-term capacity bump for Black Friday

Looping in officially. Per our playbook for strategic renewals: we should offer a small, one-time concession for provisional commits that preserve availability.

I authorize up to a 30% courtesy discount on the prorated provisional top-up charge for BrightCommerce (applies only to the 3-day commit, not to baseline or PAYG overrun). If we can convert this into a short-term commit and track it as an upsell (RDW-4892), flag it in the amendment so finance can process the credit.

Ben — please prepare the amendment with the 3-day provisional top-up line item, prorated charge, and a 30% discount line. Attach the amendment and route the DocuSign to Emily.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Note: keep runbook updated after Nov spike for future pricing guidance.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@brightcommerce.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05 09:22 -0700
Subject: Draft amendment & billing note (RDW-4892)

Hi Emily — attaching the amendment draft for the provisional capacity top-up (3 days, Nov 26-28) with the prorated charge and the 30% one-time discount Lauren approved.

Key points in amendment:
- Provisional Capacity: GPU-backed pool sized for estimated 6x traffic; capacity reserved Nov 26 00:00 - Nov 28 23:59 (UTC).
- Charge: prorated daily rate for the committed capacity x 3 days, then less 30% one-time courtesy credit.
- Fallback: if your actual usage is below the provisional commit, we will credit the difference back to your account as usage credits within 30 days.
- If usage exceeds the provisional pool we will bill overrun at standard PAYG rates.

Please review the attached PDF amendment and let me know if you'd like me to send it via DocuSign. We also included an optional clause for an automatic rollback to PAYG if expected traffic doesn't materialize — reduces risk for you.

Attachment: amendment-draft-RDW-4892.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations
ben_carter@redwood.com

Thanks team — this looks good and appreciated. A couple of quick clarifications before I route to legal/billing:
1) Can you confirm the crediting process if we under-utilize the provisional pool? We prefer an invoice credit against the November invoice, rather than a credit to future usage.
2) For auditing purposes our finance team needs a short note on how you calculate the prorated daily charge (link to formula or example is perfect).

If you can confirm both items and push the DocuSign, we will aim to return the signed amendment within 48 hours.

Best,
Emily
